snapshot.ldtHeadSubject: fix(manifest): trust RAIL_ENGINE_BINDINGS when engine tree is absent

missionPremise: A3 (2026-08-21) showed the inspect GET still SELECTs place_layer_snapshots and disposeTier2Flood refuses every snapshot flood value (SS-W16). Ledger already counts flood-hazard-fact. Sellable WDLL item 3 requires inspect to READ the atom, not revive the tile-centre NFHL bake. Dual-grammar bind is in scope because R-07 Q8 measured flood-hazard-fact entity_id as both {fips}:{prop} and {fips}:{prop}.00000000. Source: _dispatches/2026-08-21_s1-flood-inspect_dispatch.md, _inbox/2026-08-21_a3-flood_close.json, _inbox/2026-08-21_r07_store_grade.md Q8a.
completionPredicate: GET /api/brokerage/v1/place/node/:parcelNodeId/facets returns a flood determination from flood-hazard-fact atoms, or a typed refusal that names the atom miss (tried keys included). tier2.flood stays literal null. disposeTier2Flood still refuses every snapshot producer. ci-tier2-flood-not-served still flags a flood: value assignment in brokerageNodeFacets.ts. Tests fail if a snapshot flood value is served AND pass when a fixture atom yields a value. Gold 48021:34137 has a fixture or live result. No deploy, no atoms --apply, no ledger POST, P:/legacy-design-tools untouched.
scopeBasis: New READ of atoms on the inspect GET. SS-W16 snapshot refusal stays. No bake rewrite. No Harris PBF. No new ingest. Dual grammar is lookup of two entity_id strings, not a re-key writer. propertyExplorer R1 brief stays on the SS-W16 refusal this pass (dispatch names the inspect GET). Deploy and live smartsite.cloud GET are planner leave_behind.

snapshotPathUnchanged.disposeTier2Flood: total refusal, no branch returns a value
snapshotPathUnchanged.Tier2Overlay.flood: literal null type plus flood: null assignment (ci-tier2-flood-not-served requires both)
snapshotPathUnchanged.loadBakedNodeFacetSnapshot: still SELECTs place_layer_snapshots for zoning/land-use/base; still never copies payload.flood onto the wire

newReadPath.whyNotTier2Flood: ci-tier2-flood-not-served greps flood\s*: and fails any non-null assignment in brokerageNodeFacets.ts. Putting the atom value on tier2.flood would red the gate AND revive the retired key. Bypass named in that gate: a NEW field under a DIFFERENT name. Using that bypass for atoms (not for snapshots) is the intended replacement.
newReadPath.store: ATOMS_DATABASE_URL -> hauska_mcp.atoms. Never DATABASE_URL (that name is the deployment store in api-server).
newReadPath.query: SELECT entity_id, body FROM atoms WHERE entity_type = 'flood-hazard-fact' AND entity_id = ANY($2::text[]). Point lookup on unique (entity_type, entity_id). Not a heavy scan.
newReadPath.pool: module-level singleton, not a new Pool per GET

bindRule.keys: always both grammars: integer {fips}:{prop} and padded {fips}:{prop}.00000000
bindRule.inboundPadded: if the path already ends in .00000000, integer form is the prefix without that suffix
bindRule.zeroHits: typed refusal code=atom-miss, tried=[both keys], never a silent null
bindRule.twoHitsAgree: serve one, name both tried and boundAs
bindRule.twoHitsDisagree: typed refusal code=bind-conflict; do not pick a zone
bindRule.storeMissing: typed refusal code=atoms-store-not-configured; never score as miss and never read place_layer_snapshots as substitute

divergenceInTests.why: a test that seeds the same zone on both stores can pass while still serving the snapshot. Distinct values prove which store answered.

threeQuestionGate.control: ci-tier2-flood-not-served (existing) plus unit tests on bind keys and atom present/miss/conflict
threeQuestionGate.whatExecutesIt: GitHub Actions job plus vitest in artifacts/api-server
threeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: PR / push to main (CI); local vitest this lane
threeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenViolated: CI non-zero if flood: value reassigned in brokerageNodeFacets.ts. Vitest fail if snapshot AE/FLOODWAY/512.4 appear on the wire while atom is AO, or if miss is a silent null.
threeQuestionGate.whatBypassesIt: A second route that copies place_layer_snapshots.flood onto a differently named field. Tests assert floodHazardFact.source is flood-hazard-fact and snapshot-only tokens are absent from that field.

ssW16SnapshotsStayRefused.falsifier: GET or extractTier2Overlay emits tier2.flood non-null, or disposeTier2Flood returns a non-refused state

ciTier2FloodNotServedStaysClean.falsifier: scan() in pr-checks.yml returns offenders, or flood: null; / flood: null, markers missing

dualGrammarAlwaysTwoKeys.falsifier: a third key, a missing padded form, or inbound padded not inverted

missIsNamedRefusal.expect: code atom-miss with tried keys, floodHazardFact not null
missIsNamedRefusal.falsifier: floodHazardFact omitted or null with no code

gold48021.expect: UNMEASURED until point lookup; then present from atoms OR atom-miss naming both keys
gold48021.falsifier: silent null, or a value whose source is place_layer_snapshots

adversarialReview.objection: Composing floodHazardFact inside loadBakedNodeFacetSnapshot would also feed the paid R1 brief.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch names the inspect GET. R1 brief tests currently require flood section data null plus SS-W16 refusal. Wiring the atom there is a second card. GET-only compose this pass.
adversarialReview.disposition: GET-only. Named as leave_behind if the brief should follow.

adversarialReview.objection: Opening pg.Pool per request on an anonymous GET would leak connections.
adversarialReview.response: Singleton from ATOMS_DATABASE_URL. Tests inject a queryable and never open a pool.
adversarialReview.disposition: Proceed with singleton plus test injection.

adversarialReview.objection: If both grammars hit with different zones, serving either is a silent pick.
adversarialReview.response: bind-conflict refusal. Fail closed. Same class as dual-grammar miss.
